notes.page_content: The manuscript describes a binary decomposition of X by two subsets, calls their intersection E the equator, discusses closed/connected hemispheres and the written closure-intersection condition, then defines the qualified non panachées/penchées/parallèles relation. It writes Sigma_1^+ intersect Sigma_2^+ = empty, the two inclusion/equality rows, and the final Sigma_12 definition and nonemptiness expression. All assertions here are attributed to the manuscript.
notes.author_own_uncertainty: No explicit à vérifier, sauf erreur, je présume or question-marked mathematical step observed on this sheet. Reader doubts concern ink; they are not attributed as author doubts.
notes.title_date_page_counts: No separate title, date, or author page count observed. The opening noun phrase and lower adjective are underlined. Archive corner number 25 is retained only as a comment.
notes.mathematics_led_reading: No mathematical expectation was used to supply a missing glyph, repair the absent sont after si les Sigma, match the second pair delimiters, or alter the unusual final raised -,0/alpha,0/-alpha,0 cluster. The written i.e. labels and equalities remain manuscript assertions.
notes.proof_check_scope: No proof check was performed. Reading the assertions supplies no proof verification.
